verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch has no documented built-in scheduler or recurring monitors. Its CLI can run collection tests from 'an automated system' and is described as enabling 'automated API monitoring', so recurring runs appear possible only by pairing the CLI with an external scheduler such as cron or CI. The JUnit reporting from `hopp test` supports that pipeline use. Missing for 10: a native scheduling/recurring-job feature, any documentation of schedule configuration (intervals, triggers, history), and hands-on or independent corroboration of scheduled runs.
